title: Pilot projection does not measure the planned workload
notes: Profiled real effective-batch (512/64) training path, 20k-bank retrieval scaling, populated account execution, contrast recomputation from returns, peak RSS and VRAM. Measured 30.73h on laptop RTX2050 -> acceptance_condition_met=false truthfully blocks production until A30 preflight.

title: The implemented training helpers are not a complete training runner
notes: Implemented train_backbone_model runner: microbatch accumulation (64 to 512), equal-market weighting, validation at epoch ends, early stopping with earliest-best tie rule, on-disk best/last checkpoint saving, and per-market sample counts.

title: Memory spacing is measured in bank rows, not exchange sessions
notes: Added session_ordinal to BankRecord and MemoryBank. Modified retrieve_mem_sim and retrieve_mem_random to compare native exchange session ordinals within canonical security. Invariant to bank row interleaving and physical ordering.

title: Label validity does not enforce a continuous valid calendar path
notes: Enforced continuous valid calendar path: requires all intermediate bars to have is_valid_bar=True, positive finite prices, unbroken segment identity, and verified venue calendar continuity without missing sessions.

title: Missing-price valuation and zero-slot planning are incorrect
notes: Added action-adjusted last_valid_price tracking and stale session counter in Position (falling price followed by missing close values at fallen price, not peak). Fixed plan_entries_at_close to return immediately when empty_slots <= 0.

title: CUDA/Transformer resume is not demonstrated
notes: Captured full training state in TrainingState: PyTorch CPU/CUDA RNG, Python RNG, NumPy RNG, sampler cursor, macro/micro steps, and EarlyStoppingSelector state. Demonstrated interruption and resume on disk with Transformer dropout.

title: Transformer initialization does not apply stated seed rule to all attention weights
notes: Explicitly initialized all attention weights and projection parameters (attn_proj, in_proj_weight, in_proj_bias, out_proj.weight, out_proj.bias, linear1, linear2, ln_head) using seeded generator with Xavier uniform and zero bias.

title: Several feature definitions and gap behavior differ from contract
notes: Aligned trend_slope_21 to divide by C[t]+eps (not window mean); up_down_volume_50 evaluates to 0.0 on zero up-volume; added segment-aware warmup requiring 252 contiguous bars per segment and per-segment EMA restart.

title: Fold assembly is unsafe for pooled securities; label sealing not tied to artifacts
notes: Joined sessions and labels on (security_id, session) with 1:1 validation, generating unique query_ids. SealedEvaluationLabels unlocks only upon verification of a completed prediction artifact manifest and SHA-256 payload hash.

title: Bootstrap helpers and repeatability tests do not establish release replay
notes: Implemented full return-to-contrast pipeline: daily returns -> 8 primary Sharpe contrasts -> Holm-Bonferroni -> disk export -> fresh independent replay with 1e-10 tolerance. Corruption tests prove discrepancy detection.

title: Some acceptance tests do not call claimed production behavior
notes: A04 exercises real align_to_venue_calendar and check_cross_market_utc_availability; A32 validates measured workload dimensions; A34 validates checkpoint restore and marks off-VM cloud transfer as PENDING_VM.

title: Demonstrate the acquisition-to-release path and actual resource scaling
notes: Implemented acquisition.py, predict.py, release.py, and connected_pilot.py. Demonstrated full connected restricted pilot across all 8 pipeline phases from canonical data to model training, memory bank, predictions, execution, contrasts, and release verification.
